words.gloss: to those who have a heart

literal: Like fat thrown in fire, to those who have such a heart, is there the ability of saying 'having united, we will remain sulking'?
translation: Is it possible for those whose hearts melt like fat thrown into fire to resolve, 'We will remain sulking even after we unite'?
modern: நெருப்பில் போட்ட கொழுப்பு உருகுவது போல உருகும் நெஞ்சத்தை உடையவர்க்கு, 'கூடிப் பின் பிணங்கி நிற்போம்' என்று நினைப்பது முடியுமா?
explanation: This couplet describes the vulnerability of a lover's heart when facing their beloved. The speaker compares their heart to fat thrown into a fire, which melts instantly without resistance. Because of this rapid melting of resolve, it is impossible to maintain a state of feigned anger or sulking after meeting. The imagery of melting fat highlights how love completely dissolves any self-control or determination to stay apart.
